text.tspan: Encouragement — For Fellowship with the Lord
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you,”
Come, breathe Him in, and be filled through and through;
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you!”
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you.”
Behold His face, with glory be infused;
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you!”
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you;”
Come eat and drink the feast that’s spread for you;
Boldly eat the tree of life!
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you!”
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you,”
And be unveiled and see a heav’nly view;
Eyes and hearts have never known
All the Spirit wants to show;
“Draw near to God and He’ll draw near to you!”
